android.desc: Janitri: for Hospitals Formerly known as "DAKSH" ⚠️ Hardware Requirement: This app requires Janitri's external monitoring hardware device to function. It cannot operate independently without the Janitri hardware. Janitri: for Hospitals is a mobile tablet-based application designed to help healthcare professionals record and track health data efficiently in clinical settings. It enables registration of patients, collection of health parameters like heart rate, blood pressure, and uterine contraction data, and provides a live overview of recorded monitoring sessions. With an intuitive interface, the app supports timely tracking of patient data and allows healthcare staff to stay updated with regular reminders. Features for Hospital Use - Reminders for regular health parameter recording - View of trends in heart rate, blood pressure, and contraction data - Simple and user-friendly interface for hospital staff - Digital record-keeping of health parameters - Live data view for remote healthcare professionals - Useful for internal staff orientation and training Features for Medical Dashboards - Real-time updates on patient health data - Easy access to historical records and trends - Multi-patient overview for better data visibility ⚠️ Medical Disclaimer: This app is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. It is a data recording and management tool for use by trained healthcare professionals only.

quotes.story_title: Show HN: Our app to help nurses conduct safe deliveries in developing countries

quotes.text:
Hi HN!
We have developed a solution that helps midwives in low resource healthcare setting to conduct safe deliveries. More than 80% deliveries occur with the assistance of staff nurses in LMICs (Low Middle-Income Countries). Most of these midwives are unaware of the standard protocol for monitoring the labor during pregnancy. We visited more than 100 such healthcare settings and found that existing paper-based protocols are complicated for unskilled health workers.

Our solution helps them in monitoring the delivery and making timely interventions to save lives. It is a Mobile tablet based intelligent labor monitoring tool which not only allows the staff nurse to register and enter vital signs of a pregnant woman but also reminds to monitor the labor vitals, as per the standard intrapartum protocol. It also generates alerts in case of complications, based on an inbuilt algorithm. The doctor at a remote location can also view the live labor progress and guide the staff nurse.

We have recently released a narrow down version of our product in play store for public use. You can find it on Google PlayStore:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.janitri.wardapp.daksh
You can find more about our solution on our website: https://janitri.in (Product name is "Daksh" - Hindi word for Competent).
